answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Spiral. Each identity is enrolled by solving a fresh, server-seeded challenge whose search path must be published, and a verifier replays it under a random side-channel gale of timing noise; duplicated solutions collapse because the seed differs per enrollment. The published path forms a spiral of dependent steps, so copying or replaying another island enrollment fails replay checks. Cost per attacker identity: a unique compute search plus independent proof storage, making bulk registration linear in real work.
